Definition: of uncertain derivation; Chios, an island in the Mediterranean:--Chios.
BiblicalUsage: Chios is an island in the Aegean, named once in the record of Paul's journey to Jerusalem. The ship comes to Chios on the third day out from Miletus, a single stop on the long voyage that ends with Paul's arrest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the small stops on Paul's journey matter, because the gospel travelled one harbour at a time.
